notes.title: Sorry, we have adjusted the difficulty of the game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39721580/9bf5ecd670dcf4668c2b8765e87e151811aee08e.png[/img]
We have received feedback from the players and decided to modify the control and difficulty of the game. 
The new difficulty allows players to better complete the level, and full of a sense of achievement. 
Please rest assured that your game record will be kept. 
Finally, thank you for your understanding and support. 
The game will continue to upgrade and update levels. 

[b]Update content as follows:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mouse control optimization
[/list]
[list]
[*] New level difficulty
[/list]
[list]
[*] New reward mechanism
[/list]
[list]
[*] UI update
[/list]
[list]
[*] Physical effect optimization
[/list]

notes.title: Zombie Dungeon is now on sale
New language support update
notes.content:
In the last few days of the game release, the update was finally completed. This update mainly adds four new languages. We hope that people from more countries can play this game. 
If you have any questions about translation, please let us know through comments or email.

[b]This update includes several smaller updates and fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game start speed optimization Picture quality optimization
[/list]
[list]
[*] French, German, Japanese, Russian support
[/list]
[list]
[*] Language interface adjustment
[/list]
[list]
[*] Gold coin upper limit adjustment
[/list]
[list]
[*] Menu text translation optimization
[/list]

Finally, thank you for supporting all of us, I hope everything goes well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39721580/3a348a7466e946306a28cd886016c747aaa78c09.png[/img]

notes.title: Are You Ready？
notes.content:
[b]Hi, challenger

Our game will meet you soon, which makes me very excited. 

Although we have done a lot of tests on the level before release, we still hope to hear more feedback. 

If you have any opinions and thoughts about this game, please let us know by email or comments. 

There will be more new levels, enemies and props to meet you in the future![/b]
